{{Top|leg}}
A '''stabilization subroutine''' module provided additional computing power for a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] motivators and actuators. This allowed for smoother and more subtle movements in the process of disarming a [[Mine/Legends|mine]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' {{1st}}
